CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
                                                                                                                                                                                       declare
                                                                                                                                                                                         assigned_role public.account_role;
                                                                                                                                                                                         begin
                                                                                                                                                                                           select ar.approved_role into assigned_role
                                                                                                                                                                                               from public.access_requests ar
                                                                                                                                                                                                  where lower(ar.email) = lower(coalesce(new.email, ''))
                                                                                                                                                                                                       and ar.status = 'approved'
                                                                                                                                                                                                            and ar.approved_role is not null
                                                                                                                                                                                                               order by ar.reviewed_at desc nulls last, ar.created_at desc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  limit 1;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    insert into public.profiles(id, email, full_name, role)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      values(new.id, coalesce(new.email, ''), coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''), coalesce(assigned_role, 'parent'))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        on conflict(id) do update set email = excluded.email;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          return new;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          end;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_monitor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select coalesce(public.current_role() in ('monitor','developer'), false) $function$
